title: Player-controlled ship template
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Defines the player-controlled ship entity type. The base ship template is always co-located in the same directory (ship.json). This template adds camera definitions for all 8 camera views. Per ADR-0038, templates are loaded and validated independently of the world definition.

Physical quantities follow ADR-0008 (value+unit objects). Allowed units are defined in the central units registry (assets/json/schema/units.schema.json).

cameras.description: Camera definitions for all 8 camera views. Each camera has a position (relative to ship center in metres), a target point to look at, and an availability flag. All 8 cameras are defined, but only those with available=true are accessible to the player. This allows advanced designs (e.g., windowless ships) to have computed positions but mark them unavailable. Right-handed coordinates: +Y up, -Z forward per ADR-0006. Camera direction is derived from (target - position) normalized.

cockpit.description: Cockpit camera (inside the cockpit, typically front-upper-center).

drone.description: Drone camera (behind and above the ship).

rear.description: Rear view camera (behind at cockpit height).

cockpit.description: Cockpit overlay definition with stations and gauge slots. See cockpit.schema.json.

camera.description: Camera definition with position, target (look-at point), and availability flag.

position.description: Camera position relative to ship center (metres).

target.description: Point the camera looks at, relative to ship center (metres). Direction = normalize(target - position).

available.description: If true, this camera is physically present and accessible. If false, the position/target are computed but the camera is not available to the player.
